The hospital capacity risk calculation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a robust implementation of the weighted assessment logic.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and passed the legacy pytest suite in test_output.py without exceptions. While the mean reward reached 1.000 across trials, the judge_reward of 0.82 suggests potential for refinement in edge-case handling or documentation. Future iterations should re-check the weighting constants to ensure they align with specific clinical risk thresholds used in the task_id.
